info.title: Fenergo Nebula Digital Agents Query
info.description:
**DigitalAgents Query API**:
DigitalAgents Query API provides methods to access data related to agents and statistics associated with their work.
**DigitalAgents Query API provides**:
  • The ability to query metrics related to digital agents work.

AgentCategory.description: Represents the category of an agent in the digital agents system.

id.description: Gets or sets the agent identifier.

name.description: Gets or sets the name of the agent.

description.description: Gets or sets the description of the agent.

agentType.description: Gets or sets the agent type.

configurationType.description: Gets or sets the configuration type (instance or profile).

agentAutonomy.description: Gets or sets the agent autonomy.

enabled.description: Gets or sets agent enabled status.

journeyTypes.description: Gets or sets the journey types

extensionData.description:
Gets or sets the opt-in, domain-specific extension data bag (AB#549014). Populated only for
domains whose underlying `Agent` subclass implements `IHasAgentExtensionData`
(e.g. Significance, DataSourcing); null/omitted for all other domains.

AgentType.description: Represents the type of digital agent.

docsSplitAcceptanceRate.description: KYRA:Docs splitting-accuracy % for the prior period. Same null-when-no-activity convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.DocsSplitAcceptanceRate.

sourceAutoResolutionRate.description: KYRA:Source auto-resolution rate for the prior period. Same null-when-no-activity convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.SourceAutoResolutionRate.

signalUndeterminedRate.description: KYRA:Signal undetermined-verdict rate for the prior period. Same null-when-no-activity convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.SignalUndeterminedRate.

AgentValueSummaryPriorPeriodDto.description:
Aggregate action counts + accuracy rates for the period immediately preceding the requested
[From, To] range, of the same length (AB#547471) — lets BusinessMetrics compute a per-agent
trend direction and a real prior-period action count without a second round-trip. Deliberately
a flat sibling block, not a duplicate of Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto — only the
counts and rates a trend/prior-count calculation needs, not the full monthly-series/QA-findings
payload for a comparison period nobody asked for at that granularity.

AgentValueSummaryRequestDto.description: Request body DTO for the agent value summary endpoint.

screeningSanctionsCount.description:
Number of screening hits classified as Sanctions.
Populated from the per-category measure names emitted by Fenergo.Nebula.Screening (AB#543745).

screeningPepsCount.description:
Number of screening hits classified as PEPs.
Populated from the per-category measure names emitted by Fenergo.Nebula.Screening (AB#543745).

screeningAdverseMediaCount.description:
Number of screening hits classified as Adverse Media.
Populated from the per-category measure names emitted by Fenergo.Nebula.Screening (AB#543745).

idpFieldExtractedCount.description:
`IDP_field_extracted_count` Timestream measure count for the Document agent (AB#547917;
            promoted onto this shared base — and therefore onto Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.MonthlyAgentBucketDto — by
            AB#550406). Same query/aggregation shape as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueCountsDto.DocsClassified. Feeds BusinessMetrics'
            Capacity gauge "Data field extractions" pricing metric via `CapacityAgentActionCountsDto.Extraction`
            on the total, and its per-period capacity-consumption ledger (AB#550218) on the monthly breakdown.
            Not broken out by document type — aggregate-only.

docsClassifiedByType.description:
Per-document-type counts for documents classified within the requested date range.
Aggregate-only — not broken out per month. Sums to Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueCountsDto.DocsClassified.

operationsCategoryAgreement.description:
Per-decision-category intervention counts + agreement rate (AB#546092). Deliberately has no
default value (stays `null` when unset) — same convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.DocsClassifiedByType:
a response predating this rollout omits the field and deserializes to `null`, distinct from
an explicit empty list (genuinely zero interventions this period).

operationsMonthlyTrend.description: Monthly intervention volume + agreement-rate trend (AB#546092). Same null-vs-empty convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.OperationsCategoryAgreement.

operationsHaiAgreement.description:
Overall human-AI agreement rate across all reviewed decisions (AB#546238) — percentage of
Trust.Decision.Reviewed rows with ReviewOutcome=Confirmed. Screening-only today, same
source as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.OperationsCategoryAgreement's per-category rate (AB#546092 Open
Question 1). Null only when this DigitalAgents deploy predates the rollout — once
Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.OperationsCategoryAgreement is non-null this is always populated (0 when
genuinely zero reviews).

operationsTotalReviews.description: Total Trust.Decision.Reviewed count across all categories (AB#546238). Same null convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.OperationsHaiAgreement.

operationsOverrideRate.description: Overall override (disagreement) rate — percentage of reviewed decisions with ReviewOutcome=Overridden (AB#546238). Same null convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.OperationsHaiAgreement.

operationsAvgReviewTimeSeconds.description:
Average Trust.Decision.ReviewDuration in seconds (AB#546238), Screening-only today. Distinct
null semantics from the other Operations headline fields: this can legitimately be null even
when Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.OperationsCategoryAgreement is populated — a tenant/range with reviewed
decisions but zero review-duration records yet (recent rollout) has real category data but no
duration data. Consumers must check this independently, not gate it on the category/monthly presence.

operationsOverrideReasons.description: Override-reason breakdown across all 4 domains (AB#546238). Same null convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.OperationsHaiAgreement.

qaFindingCandidates.description:
Recent QA finding candidates (AB#547300), most-recent-first, capped at a fixed page size —
individual Trust.Decision.Overridden events, not aggregated. Same null-until-rollout
convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.OperationsHaiAgreement. BusinessMetrics (AB#547301) persists these
as mutable findings; DigitalAgents does not track status/severity beyond the placeholder on
Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.QaFindingCandidateDto.Severity.

docsSplitAcceptanceRate.description:
KYRA:Docs splitting-accuracy % — accepted / proposed across Trust.Split.Proposed/Accepted/Adjusted
(AB#547426, shipped by SmartDocs under AB#543284). Null when no split activity occurred this
period — not a manufactured 0%.

docsSplitAvgTouchTimeSeconds.description: Average KYRA:Docs split-phase touch time in seconds (AB#547426). Same null convention as Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.DocsSplitAcceptanceRate.

sourceAutoResolutionRate.description:
KYRA:Source auto-resolution rate — applied / (applied + overridden) for TaskType="AssociationMapping"
(AB#547427, shipped by Association under AB#543288). Labelled "Source" per product decision —
see `GetAgentValueSummaryQuery.BuildSourceAutoResolutionRate` for the AgentName caveat. Null
when no AssociationMapping activity occurred this period.

signalVerdictDistribution.description:
KYRA:Signal verdict distribution (AB#547428, shipped by Significance under AB#543289). Empty
list when no Significance activity occurred this period — not the null-until-rollout convention
used elsewhere in this DTO, since AB#543289 already ships in every environment this endpoint runs in.

signalUndeterminedRate.description: KYRA:Signal undetermined-verdict rate (AB#547428). Null when Fenergo.Nebula.DigitalAgents.Query.Application.Features.GetAgentValueSummary.AgentValueSummaryResponseDto.SignalVerdictDistribution is empty.

MonthlyAgentBucketDto.description: Per-month aggregate counts for the agent value summary.

interventionCount.description: Count of Trust.Decision.Overridden rows for this category. Uniformly available across all 4 domains.

agreementRate.description: Percentage of reviewed decisions confirmed (not overridden). Null when no review denominator exists for this category.

reviewCount.description: Count of Trust.Decision.Reviewed rows for this category. Null when no review denominator exists for this category.

OperationsCategoryDto.description:
Per-decision-category intervention count and agreement rate, sourced from Trust.Decision.Overridden
(all four domains) and Trust.Decision.Reviewed (Screening only today — see AB#546092 Open Question 1).

interventionCount.description: Count of Trust.Decision.Overridden rows for the month, summed across all categories.

agreementRate.description: Percentage of reviewed decisions confirmed this month, summed across categories with a review denominator. Null when none exists.

OperationsMonthlyBucketDto.description: Monthly intervention volume and agreement-rate trend, summed across all decision categories.

reason.description: Verbatim Trust.Decision.Overridden OverrideReason value, or "Unspecified" when empty/missing.

count.description: Count of overrides with this reason.

pct.description: Percentage of all overrides (including Unspecified) with this reason, rounded to 1dp.

OperationsOverrideReasonDto.description:
Override-reason breakdown for Trust.Decision.Overridden, across all 4 domains (AB#546238).
Rows with an empty/missing OverrideReason (SmartDocs' Overridden/AcceptedWithChanges paths,
domains that don't populate the field) bucket under "Unspecified" rather than being dropped.

agentExecutionId.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier of the agent execution.

agentCategory.description: Gets or sets the category of the agent that was executed.

agentType.description: Gets or sets the type of the agent that was executed.

outcome.description: Gets or sets the execution outcome result.

entryId.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the related entry.

metadata.description: Gets or sets the metadata associated with the outcome.

timestamp.description: Gets or sets the time stamp of the outcome.

OutcomeDto.description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing the outcome of a digital agent execution.

id.description:
The finding's natural key — the source event's EntryId when present (rows written since
AB#547300's rollout), else a composite `AgentExecutionId+Timestamp` fallback for
pre-rollout rows.

agent.description: The agent whose decision was overridden/reviewed.

issue.description:
A short description of what was flagged. The source event's OverrideReason when populated
(Screening today), else falls back to the domain's DecisionType — most domains don't capture
a real reviewer-supplied reason yet, so this is a best-effort label, not a true diagnosis.

severity.description:
Coarse severity placeholder (AB#547300) — NOT a real severity model. No confidence/score/
magnitude signal exists anywhere in the underlying Trust.Decision.* telemetry today (see
`GetAgentValueSummaryQueryHandler.DeriveSeverity` for the exact rule and why).

QaFindingCandidateDto.description:
A single QA finding candidate (AB#547300) — one qualifying Trust.Decision.Overridden event,
individually (not aggregated), for BusinessMetrics to consume and persist as a mutable
`QaFinding` (AB#547301). Read-only/point-in-time: DigitalAgents does not track status
(open/in review/resolved) — that's owned by BusinessMetrics once a finding is persisted.

verdict.description: "Significant" | "Insignificant" | "Undetermined" (verbatim Verdict dimension value), or "Unknown" when missing.
